dossier.identity: gravity breaker who pulls a squad of enemies into one place and shoves them out of it, turning the lane into a tide she controls~
dossier.selectionRationale: breaker because the harpoon rifle moves enemies rather than damaging them: pulls, slows and a repulsion wave break formations and hand allies exposed, stacked targets. distinct from mira's single gravity cage and rook's armour cracking by owning the pull-then-push rhythm. hypothesis kit (owner decision 2026-11-07).
dossier.weaponConcept: abyss harpoon (gravity-harpoon rifle with a magnetic harpoon for pull and anchor, a mass chamber generating the gravity field, a gel coolant loop, a recoil-control stabilizer frame and a phase battery power cell)

lore.backstory: a deep-salvage diver who hauled sunken districts off the seabed with a gravity harpoon and never lost a crew to the pressure. when the tide gates were privatized she kept the harpoon and now drags whole firefights to where she wants them, then lets go~
lore.syndicateRecord: wanted for towing a corporate pump station three kilometres inland and for repeated unlicensed tidal events in a financial district.
lore.psychProfile: warm, unhurried and a little too comfortable with crushing depths; believes everything finds its level and she is just helping it along.
lore.combatQuote: “pull harder. the world flows for us, darling, so stop swimming against it.”

iconFamily.subject: a bold harpoon head pulling a single chunky spiral tide swirl
iconFamily.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: one base raster concept for a game ability icon, to be traced into SVG. Character: Brine. Theme: gravity tide. Subject: a bold harpoon head pulling a single chunky spiral tide swirl. Centered compact square silhouette, fills 82% of canvas. Flat solid black monochromatic ink on genuinely transparent background. Exceptionally bold clean outer contour, broad shapes and large negative-space gaps. Recognizable at 24 to 30 pixels. No tiny details, thin lines, text, badges, borders, HUD elements, colored accents, gradients, shadows, textures or 3D. ONE original base emblem, not a sheet or variants. All four subsequent ability variations must keep this same identifiable theme.
iconFamily.method: built-in image generation, then silhouette tracing, then four SVG variations
